manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp225,476-478 defines BETWEEN ItemTransfer, source/target stations, scheduled TFTIME, and TFDT as transport time from departure to arrival. It says nominal stock updates when the transfer is actually performed and may be delayed; direct source/target timing is to be observed. pp681-683 and 717 define tracked item-position STSZ/STOHA. Installed dictionary gives seven-column transfer schema.
controlled_design: Accepted I02.var03 BETWEEN parent has one h4 IN and one h6 DEPOT-01→BASE-01 transfer with TFDT0. Child changes only that BETWEEN TFDT cell from0 to2.0 and the description; 30 other tables unchanged. Item.TRACK=Y, half-hour ITEM collection, seed1, E04 FAST support structure, and 36h horizon are held fixed. This isolates a positive two-hour delay against accepted zero-delay parent, within an IN-then-BETWEEN sequence.

pre_run_hypotheses.delay: One BETWEEN task should leave DEPOT-01 at h6 and arrive BASE-01 at h8 with the same physical item ID. Depot stock should decrease at departure and base on-hand should increase at arrival. Exact nominal STSZ timing at source and target is to be read directly from two station ItemResults series, not inferred from the log.
pre_run_hypotheses.later_demand: The first ordinary failure occurs after the scheduled transfer arrival under the frozen seed; later item identities, demand, repair, mission outcomes and report totals must be compared with the accepted TFDT0 parent without assuming equality in advance.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, no h6/h8 separation, unexpected physical ID, absent item table, report/log mismatch, source/destination stock conservation failure or source/closure mismatch is diagnostic; no positive TFDT claim published.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run audit of accepted zero-delay BETWEEN parent, manual/dictionary pins, frozen child source and exact TFDT-only table delta
Session-0 SSH native run under host-wide mutex preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored-table roundtrip, zero conversion errors, valid SXO/report and sealed raw files
Physical departure/transit/arrival ledger and direct depot/base ItemResults STSZ/STOHA timing, in-transit reconciliation and later demand/terminal state
Author replay, independent read-only replay and final staged audit before publication
limits: Positive result would cover TFDT2 vs accepted TFDT0 for one available-stock BETWEEN after IN, one LRU/two stations/seed. It would not establish nonzero delay for IN/OUT or other TFDT values, shortage splitting, priority, reorder or procurement.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
